description.sl: Hiša Ome Resi, od vrat do štedilnika: sobe, pohištvo, lesen balkon z rožami in vse, kar potrebuješ pri mizi.
description.en: Oma Resi's house, from the door to the stove: the rooms, the furniture, the wooden balcony with its flowers and everything you need at the table.
description.it: La casa di Oma Resi, dalla porta ai fornelli: le stanze, i mobili, il balcone di legno con i fiori e tutto quello che serve a tavola.

words.example_en: The house has a balcony.
words.note: Zu Hause: at home. Nach Hause: (going) home.
words.note_sl: Zu Hause: doma. Nach Hause: domov.
words.note_it: Zu Hause: a casa (stato). Nach Hause: a casa (moto).

words.example_en: Grandma is in the kitchen.
My room is small.

words.example_de: Im Winter sitzen wir in der Stube.
words.example_en: In winter we sit in the living room.
words.note: The warm main room of a farmhouse, with the tiled stove (der Kachelofen).
words.note_sl: Topla glavna soba kmečke hiše, s krušno ali lončeno pečjo (der Kachelofen); v slovenščini ji na kmetih rečejo kar hiša.
words.note_it: La stanza principale e calda del maso, con la stufa di maiolica (der Kachelofen).

words.example_en: The bathroom is upstairs.
Please close the door!
The window is open.

words.example_de: Das Essen steht auf dem Tisch.
words.example_en: The food is on the table.
Sit down on the chair!
Jakob is already in bed.
The stairs are made of wood.

words.example_de: Auf dem Balkon sind rote Blumen.
words.example_en: There are red flowers on the balcony.
words.example_it: Sul balcone ci sono fiori rossi.
words.note: Carinthian farmhouses have long wooden balconies full of flowers.
words.note_sl: Koroške kmečke hiše imajo dolge lesene balkone, polne rož.
words.note_it: Le case contadine della Carinzia hanno lunghi balconi di legno pieni di fiori.

words.example_en: Grandma is working in the garden.

words.example_de: Die Suppe ist auf dem Herd.
words.example_en: The soup is on the stove.
The milk is in the fridge.
The pot is hot!
A plate of soup, please.
words.example_it: Un piatto di minestra, per favore.

words.example_en: A glass of milk for Jakob.
words.example_it: Un bicchiere di latte per Jakob.

words.example_en: The fork goes on the left.

words.example_de: Ich brauche einen Löffel für die Suppe.
words.example_en: I need a spoon for the soup.
words.example_it: Mi serve un cucchiaio per la minestra.

words.example_en: The knife goes on the right.
words.note: Die Gabel, der Löffel, das Messer: learn every noun with its article.
words.note_sl: Die Gabel, der Löffel, das Messer: vsak samostalnik se nauči s členom.
words.note_it: Die Gabel, der Löffel, das Messer: impara ogni sostantivo con il suo articolo.

words.example_de: Hilfst du mir, den Tisch zu decken?
words.example_en: Will you help me set the table?
words.example_it: Mi aiuti ad apparecchiare la tavola?
